requirement: Anyone can browse Servicios para músicos
expected: /servicios lists approved services as cards with kind, provider badge, starting price, place and rating; nothing pending, rejected, paused or hidden appears
steps: Open `/servicios` signed out

requirement: Each kind has its own page
expected: The five kind pages render with their own heading, counts and only their services
steps: Open each `/servicios/<kind>` page

requirement: Filters narrow the directory and keep their address
expected: Ciudad, Dónde, the skill and Orden chips change the list and the URL; unknown values are dropped; filtered pages are noindex, follow
steps: Filter `/servicios/clases` by Lima, En línea and Guitarra; open a garbled filter URL

requirement: Sorting by rating and by price
expected: Mejor valorados puts reviewed services first by average; Menor precio orders by starting price
steps: Sort `/servicios` both ways

requirement: Paging and empty states
expected: 24 per page with numbered pages; a page past the last redirects to the last; an empty kind explains and offers to publish
steps: Open `/servicios/sonido-para-eventos` with no approved service; open `?page=99`

requirement: Services never mix with instruments
expected: Services never appear in /listados, instrument search, category pages, listing counts, saved alerts, favorites or a store's listing allowance; the migration never writes listing tables
steps: Search the catalog for a service title; check counts and the store allowance before and after publishing a service; `tests/services.test.cjs`

requirement: A service page shows everything needed to decide
expected: Photos, details, description, reviews with breakdown, provider card with badge, WhatsApp button and the limitation line
steps: Open a seeded service page at 390 and 1366 px

requirement: Contact opens WhatsApp with a prefilled message
expected: «Contactar por WhatsApp» opens the provider's number with the service title and page; the press is recorded without blocking
steps: Press the button signed in and signed out

requirement: A service that is not public is a 404 except for its owner and Admin
expected: Pending, rejected, paused and hidden services 404 for visitors; the owner and Admin see a preview with a notice; previews are noindex
steps: Open the pending sound service signed out, as its owner and as Admin

requirement: A Particular offers a service
expected: Kind chooser, then the form; valid data goes to Por aprobar with a confirmation notice; one service per kind
steps: Offer Luthería y reparaciones as `particular@laria.test`

requirement: The form checks every field before saving and the database repeats each check
expected: Errors show under each field and in the summary; contact details in the text are refused; prices outside 1 to 100,000 and units outside the kind are refused
steps: Submit the empty form; type a phone number in the description; `tests/feat-services.sql`

requirement: A store offers services as the store
expected: A store owner without a store request is told to send it first; a store's service shows the store name, logo and verification
steps: Offer a service as `demo-tienda@laria.test`

requirement: Photos are redrawn and uploaded into the owner's folder
expected: Up to six JPEG, PNG or WebP photos under 5 MB; another folder or a nested path is refused; photos removed by an edit are deleted
steps: Upload, reorder and remove photos; `tests/feat-services.sql` storage section

requirement: Admin approves or rejects a new service
expected: Approve publishes it and notifies the owner (in app and e-mail); reject needs a reason the owner sees; both are audited
steps: Admin › Servicios › Por aprobar

requirement: Edits to an approved service stay public and are rechecked
expected: Changing title, description, name or photos lands in Cambios por revisar while public; price or zones changes do not; Admin marks it fine or hides it
steps: Edit the seeded lesson; Admin › Servicios › Cambios por revisar

requirement: A decision applies only to the version Admin saw
expected: A decision on an older version is refused with a message to reload
steps: Edit a service while its Admin row is open, then decide

requirement: A rejected or hidden service goes back to review when saved
expected: Saving it again sets it to Por aprobar and clears the reason
steps: Edit a rejected service and save

requirement: Reports on services and reviews have their own queue
expected: Report from the service page or a review; Admin sees it under Reportes; closing it needs a note and never moderates by itself; Admin can hide the service or review from there
steps: Report the seeded room; close it as Admin

requirement: Mi cuenta › Servicios shows state, reasons and figures
expected: Each service shows its state, Admin's reason, 30-day views and contacts and its rating, with Ver página, Editar, Confirmar un cliente, Pausar or Reanudar and Eliminar
steps: Open Mi cuenta › Servicios as `particular@laria.test`

requirement: Pausing hides a service and resuming shows it again
expected: A paused service leaves the directory and its page 404s for visitors; Reanudar brings it back without review
steps: Pause and resume the seeded lesson

requirement: A service with history cannot be deleted
expected: Delete works without confirmed clients or reviews and removes the page and its photos; otherwise it explains and offers Pausar
steps: Delete the seeded room; try to delete the lesson

requirement: Views and contacts are counted fairly
expected: One view per person or session per 30 minutes; the owner's and Admin's visits never count; at most 20 contacts per person and service a day
steps: `tests/feat-services.sql` events section

requirement: A client can say they hired a provider they contacted
expected: «Sí, lo contraté» appears only to someone who wrote through Laria's button signed in within 180 days; the provider is asked to confirm
steps: Contact, then claim on the service page as `comprador@laria.test`

requirement: A provider can ask a person who wrote to confirm
expected: Confirmar un cliente lists only people who wrote that way (first name and initial, date, last three digits), none preselected; already confirmed or declined people are not listed
steps: Open Confirmar un cliente as the provider

requirement: The other side confirms or declines
expected: Yes confirms and opens a 30-day review window; No closes it; a request lapses after 30 days; the asker can cancel while it waits
steps: Answer the store's request as `comprador@laria.test`

requirement: Confirmation requests are limited
expected: At most 30 requests per account a day
steps: `tests/feat-services.sql`

requirement: Only a confirmed client reviews, once, within 30 days
expected: The review form has no preselected stars and an optional comment; a second review, a review after 30 days or from someone else is refused; the review shows the first name and initial
steps: Review the seeded lesson as `comprador@laria.test`

requirement: Admin can hide or show a review, never rewrite it
expected: Hiding needs a reason, removes it from the page and the average; showing it again restores it; both audited
steps: Admin › Servicios › Reseñas

requirement: Owners and clients are told about real changes only
expected: In-app notices for approval, rejection, hiding, a confirmation request, a confirmation, a decline and a new review; e-mails for approval, rejection, hiding, a request and a confirmation; links go to Mi cuenta › Servicios
steps: Walk through the flows and open Notificaciones

requirement: Tables are closed; everything goes through RPCs
expected: Anonymous and signed-in users cannot read or write the service tables directly; owner RPCs refuse other accounts; Admin RPCs refuse non-admins
steps: `tests/feat-services.sql` anonymous and stranger sections

requirement: Services can be found from the footer, the account menu, Admin and the sitemap
expected: Footer Explora and Vende links, «Servicios» in the account menu after Estadísticas, Admin › Servicios, and the sitemap lists the section, the five kinds and every public service
steps: Open the footer, the account menu and `/sitemap.xml`

requirement: Terms, Privacy and Artículos prohibidos cover services
expected: Terms § 5 bis and Privacy § 4 ter describe the section, its limits and the data; Artículos prohibidos points services to the section; wording approved by legal review
steps: Open `/terminos#servicios`, `/privacidad#servicios`, `/articulos-prohibidos`

requirement: No promises Laria cannot keep
expected: No copy says Laria verifies titles, experience or work, holds or processes payments, or guarantees a booking; no urgency or scarcity
steps: Read every services page; `tests/services.test.cjs`

requirement: Services pages pass axe at 390 and 1366 px
expected: No WCAG 2.2 A or AA violations on the directory, service page, Mi cuenta and Admin states; every action is a button or link of at least 24 px
steps: `node scripts/prototype/services-screens.cjs`
